## Setup

```{r}
devtools::load_all("../../..")
library(lomad)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Load example data

Favorable setting: high n, low phi, high SNR. Unfavorable setting: low n, low phi, low SNR.

```{r}
fav   <- readRDS("results/_simulations-power/_raw/smooth_d0-5_n600_snr1-5_phi0-3-series.rds")
unfav <- readRDS("results/_simulations-power/_raw/smooth_d0-5_n600_snr0-5_phi0-3-series.rds")
```

## Inspect structure

```{r}

# Pull one replicate to prototype
rep1 <- fav[[1]]

h_win <- 5L
n     <- length(fav[[1]]$w)

pool_fav <- lapply(fav, function(rep) {
  t_seq        <- rep$vi
  window_max   <- sapply(t_seq, function(t) {
    idx <- max(1, t - h_win):min(n, t + h_win)
    max(abs(1 - rep$w[idx]))
  })
  data.frame(
    window_max = window_max,
    rejected   = rep$rejected[t_seq]
  )
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

table(pool_fav$rejected)
summary(pool_fav$window_max[pool_fav$rejected])
summary(pool_fav$window_max[!pool_fav$rejected])
```

```{r}
# Sensitivity-like: P(rejected | max|1-w| > c) as a function of c
c_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)

sens_curve <- sapply(c_grid, function(c) {
  above <- pool_fav$window_max > c
  if (sum(above) == 0) return(NA)
  mean(pool_fav$rejected[above])
})

plot(c_grid, sens_curve, type = "l",
     xlab = "Threshold c", ylab = "P(rejected | max|1-w| > c)",
     main = "Sensitivity curve — favorable setting")
abline(h = 0.05, lty = 2, col = "grey60")
```

```{r}
n_unfav <- length(unfav[[1]]$w)

pool_unfav <- lapply(unfav, function(rep) {
  t_seq      <- rep$vi
  window_max <- sapply(t_seq, function(t) {
    idx <- max(1, t - h_win):min(n_unfav, t + h_win)
    max(abs(1 - rep$w[idx]))
  })
  data.frame(window_max = window_max, rejected = rep$rejected[t_seq])
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

table(pool_unfav$rejected)
```

```{r}
c_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)

sens_curve_unfav <- sapply(c_grid, function(c) {
  above <- pool_unfav$window_max > c
  if (sum(above) == 0) return(NA)
  mean(pool_unfav$rejected[above])
})

plot(c_grid, sens_curve_unfav, type = "l",
     xlab = "Threshold c", ylab = "P(rejected | max|1-w| > c)",
     main = "Sensitivity curve — unfavorable setting")
abline(h = 0.05, lty = 2, col = "grey60")
```

```{r}
sens_df <- data.frame(
  c       = rep(c_grid, 2),
  p_reject = c(sens_curve, sens_curve_unfav),
  setting = rep(c("Favorable (n=600, snr=1.5, phi=0.3)",
                  "Unfavorable (n=200, snr=0.5, phi=0.3)"), each = length(c_grid))
)

ggplot(sens_df, aes(x = c, y = p_reject, colour = setting)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00")) +
  labs(x = "Threshold c", y = "P(rejected | max|1-w| > c)",
       title = "Sensitivity curves — favorable vs unfavorable",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Favorable individual runs

```{r}
## Load series files for all three structures (favorable setting)
fav_smooth <- readRDS("results/_simulations-power/_raw/smooth_d1-0_n600_snr1-5_phi0-3-series.rds")
fav_cross  <- readRDS("results/_simulations-power/_raw/cross_d1-0_n600_snr1-5_phi0-3-series.rds")
fav_rate   <- readRDS("results/_simulations-power/_raw/rate_d1-0_n600_snr1-5_phi0-3-series.rds")

# Pick 3 replicates from each that have some rejections
pick_reps <- function(series_obj, n_pick = 5) {
  has_rejection <- sapply(series_obj, function(rep) any(rep$rejected, na.rm = TRUE))
  chosen <- sample(names(series_obj)[has_rejection], n_pick)
  series_obj[chosen]
}

set.seed(42)
reps_smooth <- pick_reps(fav_smooth)
reps_cross  <- pick_reps(fav_cross)
reps_rate   <- pick_reps(fav_rate)

make_rep_df <- function(reps, structure) {
  lapply(seq_along(reps), function(i) {
    rep  <- reps[[i]]
    data.frame(
      t         = seq_along(rep$w),
      w         = rep$w,
      decoupling = abs(1 - rep$w),
      rejected  = rep$rejected,
      rep_id    = paste0(structure, " — rep ", i),
      structure = structure
    )
  }) |> bind_rows()
}

plot_df <- bind_rows(
  make_rep_df(reps_smooth, "smooth"),
  make_rep_df(reps_cross,  "cross"),
  make_rep_df(reps_rate,   "rate")
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = t)) +
  geom_tile(aes(y = 0.5, height = Inf, fill = rejected), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = decoupling)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#D55E00", "FALSE" = "grey90"),
                    na.value = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ rep_id, ncol = 5) +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "|1 - w|", fill = "Rejected",
       title = "Decoupling over time with rejected regions — favorable setting") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Helper functions

```{r}
compute_pool <- function(series_obj, h) {
  n <- length(series_obj[[1]]$w)
  lapply(series_obj, function(rep) {
    t_seq      <- rep$vi
    window_max <- sapply(t_seq, function(t) {
      idx <- max(1, t - h):min(n, t + h)
      max(abs(1 - rep$w[idx]))
    })
    data.frame(window_max = window_max, rejected = rep$rejected[t_seq])
  }) |> bind_rows()
}

compute_sens_curve <- function(pool, c_grid) {
  sapply(c_grid, function(c) {
    above <- pool$window_max > c
    if (sum(above) == 0) return(NA)
    mean(pool$rejected[above])
  })
}

compute_sens_curve_col <- function(pool, col, c_grid) {
  sapply(c_grid, function(c) {
    above <- pool[[col]] > c
    if (sum(above, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NA)
    mean(pool$rejected[above], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}

compute_pool_stats <- function(series_obj, h) {
  n <- length(series_obj[[1]]$w)
  lapply(series_obj, function(rep) {
    t_seq <- rep$vi
    stats <- t(sapply(t_seq, function(t) {
      idx  <- max(1, t - h):min(n, t + h)
      vals <- abs(1 - rep$w[idx])
      c(win_max          = max(vals),
        win_mean         = mean(vals),
        win_median       = median(vals),
        center           = abs(1 - rep$w[t]),
        duration         = mean(vals > 0.05),
        total_decoupling = sum(vals))
    }))
    data.frame(stats, rejected = rep$rejected[t_seq])
  }) |> bind_rows()
}

c_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)
h      <- 5L
```

```{r}
stat_cols_all <- c("win_max", "win_mean", "win_median", "center", "duration", "total_decoupling")

sens_all_df <- bind_rows(lapply(
  list(smooth = pool_smooth, cross = pool_cross, rate = pool_rate),
  function(pool) {
    bind_rows(lapply(stat_cols_all, function(col) {
      data.frame(c = c_grid, p = compute_sens_curve_col(pool, col, c_grid), statistic = col)
    }))
  }
), .id = "structure")

ggplot(sens_all_df, aes(x = c, y = p, colour = statistic)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  facet_wrap(~ structure, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Threshold c", y = "P(rejected | statistic > c)",
       title = "All summary statistics — unfavorable setting (h_win = 5)",
       colour = "Statistic") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Sensitivity by structure

```{r}
pool_smooth <- compute_pool_stats(unfav_smooth, h)
pool_cross  <- compute_pool_stats(unfav_cross,  h)
pool_rate   <- compute_pool_stats(unfav_rate,   h)

stat_cols <- c("win_max", "duration", "total_decoupling")

sens_stats_df <- bind_rows(lapply(
  list(smooth = pool_smooth, cross = pool_cross, rate = pool_rate),
  function(pool) {
    bind_rows(lapply(stat_cols, function(col) {
      data.frame(c = c_grid, p = compute_sens_curve_col(pool, col, c_grid), statistic = col)
    }))
  }
), .id = "structure")

ggplot(sens_stats_df, aes(x = c, y = p, colour = statistic)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("win_max"          = "#0072B2",
                                 "duration"         = "#009E73",
                                 "total_decoupling" = "#D55E00")) +
  facet_wrap(~ structure, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Threshold c", y = "P(rejected | statistic > c)",
       title = "Sensitivity by summary statistic — unfavorable setting (h_win = 5)",
       colour = "Statistic") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
